title: Recursive dot product state as a sum
statement: Let $\mathbb{F}_2$ be the field with two elements, let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $a,b\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$. For every nonnegative integer $k$, the recursive dot product state after $k$ steps equals $\sum_{j=0}^{k-1} a_jb_j$, where a coordinate with index at least $\ell$ is interpreted as zero.
